fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Enforcement Constable 2023 Final Result – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Board (UPSSSC) has released the Final Result for selection to the posts of Enforcement Constable under the Advt. No. 04-Exam/2023. The vacancy came in the year 2023 and it took almost one year nine month to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. The PET examination was held on 22 February 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSSSC Enforcement Constable 2023 Final Result from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 July 2023
  • Last Date : 28 July 2023
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 July 2023
  • Correction Last Date : 04 August 2023
  • Eligibility Result Available : 06 February 2024
  • Exam Date : 11 May 2025
  • Exam City Details : 01 May 2025
  • Admit Card Available : 07 May 2025
  • Answer Key Date : 15 May 2025
  • Result : 13 November 2025
  • PET Exam Date : 22 February 2026
  • PET Admit Card : 16 February 2026
  • PET Result : 30 April 2026
  • Final Result : 30 April 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
